title: The Revolutionaries That Came Before Us Deserves The Respect Given. #history #news #motivation
cleanTitle: The Revolutionaries That Came Before Us Deserves The Respect Given.
segments: I give respect when respect is due to
the men that were before me.
Most of you [ __ ] running your mouth
wouldn't even have the job you have now
or even even live where you live
had not been for these men here.
Medgar Evers, Fred Hampton, MLK, Malcolm
X, the Black Panthers, the Brown Berets,
Young Lords, all these people rose up.
Black Panthers especially Black
Panthers.
Um um Kwame Ture or Stokely Carmichael.
All these black men rose up
on behalf of our brothers and sisters in
the 60s
to fight against injustice, to fight for
some form of equality, some form of
civility, some kind of peace.
And now Trump and his administration is
slowly relinquishing and removing all
the hard work that most of you ignorant
[ __ ] today don't even acknowledge or
even care to to uh understand.
So I love it. I don't care cuz a lot of
you black folks today are ungrateful
